Thanks, Lei — you're verified! I found your order #W5166363, which contains the Laptop (17-inch, i5, 8GB RAM, 1TB SSD, space grey) for $2,749.56, paid via PayPal. 

However, I noticed this order is still in 'pending' status — it hasn't been delivered yet. Exchanges only apply to delivered orders, so I can't process an exchange at this stage. Since the order is pending, though, I can help you modify the item options (e.g., different screen size, processor, RAM, storage, or color of the same laptop), change the shipping address or payment method, or cancel the order entirely.

Would you like to do any of these? If you'd like to modify the laptop's options, please let me know what you'd like changed.
